title: Gorbachev says various civilizations have made contact

tellings.quote: And then when we talked with the former president of the Soviet Union, Mikail Gorbachov, he also spoke about the fact that there are various civilizations that have made contact with representatives of our earth.

plain: Mikhail Gorbachev, the former leader of the Soviet Union, is said to have told visitors that various civilizations have made contact with representatives of Earth. A Russian guest named Kiran Ilum Xenov, who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, tells Michels that he and others heard Gorbachev say this when they talked with him, sometime in the 1990s. If true, it would mean a former Soviet leader privately accepted that contact had happened.
